serverInfo.name: djzs-trust-mcp
serverInfo.title: DJZS Trade Audit
serverInfo.description: Pre-execution audit for AI trading agents. Checks a prediction-market, perpetual or spot trade thesis for a stated reason, a falsification condition and bounded risk before capital is committed, returns PASS, WAIT or FAIL with a reproducible verdict hash, and looks up an agent's audit certificates and trust score.
